answer.rationale: Primary objective forbids raising delivery risk on a 94% loaded line with no buffer and a primary contract 14 days from hard expiry. Incumbent continuity historically avoided migration and delivery interruption (c1). The low-cost quote is usable as a market benchmark to reopen price and terms at renewal (c4 playbook), pursuing the 18% spend cut without a vendor change. Switching would meet the cut alone but introduces onboarding/allocation risk this cycle; deferral is unsuitable for a non-auto-renewing critical contract; a second source does not itself replace the expiring primary. Whether the incumbent will fully match 18% remains unknown.
